source.title: Pickers_Hollow_Wood_Button_Click_Source
source.original_idea: ok new sound, I need like a wood texture click sound for a button. Separate new button SFX for Picker's Hollow; preserve existing slider sounds. One candidate, 150 ms first export, no integration before user acceptance.
source.prompt: A single small wooden button click. Dry, crisp and tactile, with a warm rounded woody body, faint wood-grain texture, and an immediate short decay. Close-miked and isolated.
source.prompt_used: TrackType: SFX, A single small wooden button click. Dry, crisp and tactile, with a warm rounded woody body, faint wood-grain texture, and an immediate short decay. Close-miked and isolated, Small polished walnut pushbutton, Pressed once, one compact wooden click settling quickly to silence, Dry warm wood, a little grainy tactile texture, Very close microphone, isolated and dry.
